card_text: Mummy ka rule: bahar ka khana mehnga, ghar ka khana sehat. Bahar ka order karne par bhi mummy: "Maine toh dal banayi hai."
caption:
Mummy ki dal se bada koi competition nahi hai 🍲
Order aaye ya na aaye, thali toh lagegi hi.
Family group mein bhejo ye post.

card_text: Mood: saari duniya ko bol diya "kal se pakka", aur kal wahi purana main.
caption:
Aadat badalna aasan hai, bas kal se 😅
Nayi shuruaat ka wada hum roz karte hain.
Tag karo us dost ko jo roz "kal se" bolta hai.

card_text: Mood: kaam bahut hai, himmat nahi hai. Chai bana ke sochte hain ki kaam apne aap ho jayega.
caption:
Chai har problem ka temporary solution hai ☕
Kaam wahin pada rehta hai, hum chai ke saath philosophy karte hain.
Share karo us dost ke saath jo chai ka deewana hai.

card_text: Mood: sabko lagta hai main shant hoon. Andar se 14 tabs khule hain aur sab mein music chal raha hai.
caption:
Bahar se calm, andar se browser crash 🤯
Overthinking meri side hustle hai.
Tag karo us dost ko jo sab kuch soch leta hai.

card_text:
Expectation:
Aaj jaldi so jaunga.

Reality:
Raat 2 baje ek reel dekhte dekhte pata chala ki duniya ka sabse achha bhaalu nacha raha hai.
caption:
Ek reel aur, bas ek reel aur 😴
Phir wahi subah ki pachtawa.
Tag karo us dost ko jo kabhi jaldi nahi sota.

card_text:
Expectation:
Aaj plan banega aur sab aayenge.

Reality:
Group mein 40 "haan" aur ek bhi nahi pahuncha.
caption:
Plan banana aasan hai, nibhana nahi 😂
Group ke wada karne wale hamesha ghar pe hi milte hain.
Tag karo us dost ko jo plan cancel karta hai.

card_text:
Expectation:
Online order mein jo photo dikhi, wahi aayega.

Reality:
Packet kholke: "Ye toh uska chhota bhai hai."
caption:
Online shopping mein jo dikhta hai wo milta nahi 📦
Har baar ummeed, har baar dukh.
Tag karo us dost ko jo roz order karta hai.

card_text:
Hamesha time pe pahunchne wala dost ya jo late aata hai par sabko hasa deta hai?

Ek choose karo.
caption:

Par group trip mein kisko saath rakhoge?
Comment mein batao aur dost ko tag karo.

card_text:
Garam garam chai ya thandi cold coffee?

Dimaag ki baat mat sunna, dil se bolo.
caption:

Tumhara pick kya hai?
Tag karo us dost ko jo dusre team mein hai.

card_text:
Mummy ka gussa ya Papa ki khamoshi?

Ek toh jhelna padega.
caption:
Dono hi level pe darr lagta hai 😬
Par kaun zyada khatarnak hai?
Family group mein bhejo aur dekho kaun kya bolta hai.

card_text: Family group mein koi sawal poochho: 1 ghanta koi nahi bolta. Jaise hi "Good Night" likho, 12 replies aa jate hain.
caption:

Family group mein bhejo isse.

Tag karo us dost ko jo kabhi charger wapas nahi karta.

Aaj gym jaunga, full dedication.

Sirf 5 minute ke liye phone dekhunga.

Reality:
Sar utha ke dekha toh khidki se andhera aa gaya tha.

Phone ka 5 minute aur ghadi ke 5 minute alag hote hain 📱
Time kahan gaya, koi nahi jaanta.

YouTube dekhke ghar pe cooking seekhunga.

Reality:
Video 10 minute ka tha, safai 2 ghante ki.

Chef banne se pehle safai ka certificate chahiye 🍳

Bina network wala unlimited data ya full network wala 100 MB data?

Comment mein batao aur dost ko tag karo.

Chhutti wale din dopahar ki neend ya shaam ki chai ke saath samosa?

Ek hi milega.
caption:
Zindagi ka sabse mushkil sawal 🥟
Dono chahiye, par ek hi milega.
Comment karo aur dost ko bhejo.

card_text: Family group mein dadi ne "Good Morning" bheja. 14 log ne thumbs up diya. Dadi ne phir bola: "Sab jag rahe ho?"

Thumbs up hi hazri hai.
Family group mein bhejo.

caption:

Tag karo us dost ko jo sirf bolne mein tez hai! ✈️

Matlab: "Bhai, padh bhi le kabhi."
Office ki sabse polite gaali.
caption:
Corporate ki language mein gussa bhi tameez se aata hai 😎

card_text:
Raat ko 2 baje achanak bhookh lagna ya subah alarm bajte hi sab kuch bhool ke dobara so jaana?

Safai ka irada, yaadon ka sailab 😂

card_text: Desi ghar mein "do minute mein khana lag raha hai" ka matlab hota hai: pehle haath dho, phir table saaf karo, phir intezaar karo.
caption:
Mummy ke do minute aur duniya ke do minute alag hote hain 😄
Tum bhi bhookhe baithe ho na?
Family group mein bhejo!

card_text: Mood: sabko bol diya "ab main phone kam chalaunga." Screen time report aayi: "Aap bahut mehnat kar rahe hain."
caption:
Report ne bhi taana maar diya 📱😂
Isme se kitne log hain jo yahi bolte hain?

card_text:
Expectation:
Naya notebook, sundar likhawat, har page saaf.

Reality:
Teesre din se last page pe rough kaam aur pehle page pe chai ka daag.
caption:
Naya notebook, purani aadatein 📒😂
Har student ki kahani yahi hai.
Tag karo us dost ko jiski copy hamesha ganda hoti hai!

card_text:
Group chat mein 200 unread messages ya ghar pe 5 mehmaan achanak aa jayein?

Ek choose karo.
caption:
Dono mein hi dimaag ghoom jata hai 😵
Comment mein batao kaunsa chunoge!
Tag karo us dost ko jo 'mute' ka option jaanta hi nahi.

card_text: Family group mein koi ne "hmm" likha. Poore group mein sannata. Sab soch rahe hain: "Ye gussa hai ya sirf data bachana?"
caption:
Ek 'hmm' aur 10 tarah ke matlab 😂
Family group ka rahasya aaj tak nahi suljha.
Group mein bhejo aur dekho kaun jawab deta hai!

card_text: Sachcha dost woh hai jo tumhare "main aa raha hoon" pe bhi bol de: "Pata hai, ghar se nikal bhi nahi hoga tu. Main wahi baitha hoon."
caption:
Dost tumhe tumse zyada jaante hain 😄
Aur isi liye sabse pyaare hain.
Tag karo us dost ko jo tumhari har bahaane ki sachchai jaanta hai!

card_text: Office mein "main bas ek minute mein aata hoon" ka matlab hota hai: chai, gossip, aur wapas aate waqt kisi aur ki seat pe 20 minute.
caption:
Ek minute ka matlab office mein kuch aur hi hota hai ☕😂
Tumhare office mein bhi ye hai na?
Tag karo us colleague ko jo seat pe mil hi nahi sakta!

card_text: Padhai ke liye table saaf kiya, lamp lagaya, pen nikala. Ab itni mehnat ke baad padhna toh kal pe banta hai.
caption:
Taiyari poori, padhai adhoori 📚😂
Har student ne ye zaroor kiya hai.
Tag karo us dost ko jo setup mein hi thak jata hai!
